text:
The customer wants a refund for a duplicate charge of ₹1,299 on their card ending in 4417 from 12 Nov. 

So far, the previous agent confirmed the duplicate charge and raised a reversal with the payment partner under reference RV-220918, advising a 3–5 working day bank turnaround. 

Next, the customer is waiting for the funds to credit and plans to file a chargeback dispute with their bank if the refund does not arrive by the 20th.
